propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic plan-material-pin entry per direct child and per normalized prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ticket ID.

Plan-material-pins contain the role (child or prerequisite), canonical ticket ID, and 16-hex material fingerprint of the target ticket; duplicate edges within one role collapse and both prerequisite directions normalize to role prerequisite.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived entries, scan inbound block relations across that full map, resolve aliases and prefixes once, and expose related_material as a deterministic tuple of role/canonical_id/material_fingerprint records.

Pin collection must run before LLM evaluation; any unreadable, unresolvable, or malformed target reference raises PlanRelationSnapshotError with a specific reason enum (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, or store-read-failure) and returns unsigned INDETERMINATE without emitting a partial pin set.

tracker_head_sha() must verify the tickets tracker is clean (no dirty or unmerged files per git status --porcelain and git ls-files -u), then capture the 40-hex HEAD SHA; any git, IO, path, or subprocess failure maps to store-read-failure.

All three signing paths—ordinary sign_plan_review, progressive drift refresh_attestation, and resign_plan_review—must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and pass the complete current pin set to build_manifest; no new attestation can be minted pinless and deleted targets prevent refresh/re-sign until the relationship is repaired.
